entities.summary: James Duane Doty was an American land speculator, politician, and pioneer. He served as the 2nd governor (1841–1844) of the Wisconsin Territory and 5th governor (1863–1865) of the Utah Territory, and played a significant role in the early development of both territories. He also served two terms in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Wisconsin's 3rd congressional district from 1849 to 1853.
